payload.posture: Read Genesis 47:27–31 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states as Jacob’s death approaches, he asks Joseph for loyal action, receives an oath, and bows at the bed’s head. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
